abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion Transformers offer state-of-the-art fidelity in image and video synthesis, but their iterative sampling process remains a major bottleneck due to the high cost of transformer forward passes at each timestep.

evidence.anchor: iterative sampling process remains a major bottleneck

abstract_sentences.text: To mitigate this, feature caching has emerged as a training-free acceleration technique that reuses hidden representations.
However, existing methods often apply a uniform caching strategy across all feature dimensions, ignoring their heterogeneous dynamic behaviors.

evidence.anchor: uniform caching strategy across all feature dimensions

abstract_sentences.text: Therefore, we adopt a new perspective by modeling hidden feature evolution as a mixture of ODEs across dimensions, and introduce HyCa, a Hybrid ODE solver inspired caching framework that applies dimension-wise caching strategies.

HyCa achieves near-lossless acceleration across diverse tasks and models, including 5.55× speedup on FLUX, 5.56× speedup on HunyuanVideo, 6.24× speedup on Qwen-Image and Qwen-Image-Edit without retraining.

final_judgment.single_storyline: HyCa 将 DiT residual feature 的时间演化建模为 heterogeneous mixture of ODEs，按 trajectory descriptor 聚类 feature dimensions，并在每个 cluster 从 solver pool 选择最小 next-step error 的 predictor，以稳定 assignment 支撑离线一次选择和在线缓存。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: p.1–10 保留问题、ODE framing、cluster-wise objective、Figure 3、Tables 1–5、Figure 7 消融、LoRA 图和结论；读者可在不读附录时判断报告任务中的 speed-quality trade-off。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: A.1 放 protocol/分母与配置，A.2/A.6 放公式与 RK2 cache-only 推导，A.3–A.7 放 qualitative cases、LoRA 与极端稳定性。主文不能单独复现完整 predictor pool，也不展示 early-step exception。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 将 offline indicator-cluster-solver selection 与 online compute/skip 放入同一图，再用 Tables 1–5 的统一 acceleration/quality 列跨任务回收。
final_judgment.largest_gap: mixture-of-ODEs 是解释性 framing，未给 formal identification theorem；所有候选 solver 中只有 RK2 获得 cached-feature 离散推导，且硬件计时与跨-seed variability 未报告。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 若方法的关键主张是一次 offline selection 可在许多 online conditions 重用，主文应同时呈现选择目标、复用路径、跨条件 stability 检验和至少一个可执行 predictor 例子，并统一速度口径。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于存在明确 offline/online 分界、可测 assignment stability 和共享推理路径的系统；条件分布频繁漂移、没有足够历史 cache 或在线选择本身昂贵时，不能预设离线 assignment 可复用。

method_analysis.formal_objects: x(τ) 为 continuous latent，F(x(τ)) 为 hidden feature，gθ 为不可直接访问的 time-dependent vector field，S 为 predictor pool，ϕd 为 feature-dimension descriptor，c(d) 为 k-means cluster assignment。
method_analysis.input_output_state: 在 compute step 保存具体 DiT block 的 exact residual output Ftn；在 skip step 以历史 cached residuals 预测 F̂tn+1，并通过原 residual connection 注回 block output。
